insights.summary: Khush introduced Oltaflock AI, emphasizing its focus on assisting companies in the travel and real estate sectors. Mathew expressed a desire to learn more about the travel industry, indicating he is new to this sector. He shared his experience with AI automation, highlighting challenges with manual entry in his business, stating that 'manual entry kills my day.' Mathew discussed his current use of a host agency, which costs him $250 a month, and the need for better systems. He shared insights on lead conversion rates, noting that online inquiries convert at only 3%, while referrals convert at 85-90%. Khush proposed systems to improve lead acquisition and customer engagement, including a focus on reactivating existing leads and integrating them into a CRM system. Mathew indicated he needs help implementing systems to get more leads and direct marketing. Khush plans to create a personalized proposal based on their discussion, and Mathew agreed to review it by Tuesday. They decided to schedule a follow-up call for either Monday or Tuesday to walk through the proposal.
